name: Mouse Driven Vertical Carousel
description: Full-screen vertical list of titles over a crossfading background image, where the list scrolls with the pointer position and the hovered item becomes active.
contents: Full-bleed background image per slide with crossfade and slight scale
Vertical list of numbered eyebrow and uppercase title items
Dark radial gradient overlay for text legibility
behavior: Moving the mouse vertically translates the list proportionally to the pointer position
Hovering or touching an item makes it active and swaps the background image
Inactive items fade and shift sideways by their distance from the active one
Touch dragging moves the list the same way as the mouse
editableByProps: Slides: eyebrow, title and background image
Background color, font sizes, letter spacing, padding, list offset and transition speed through Tailwind class props

needsCodeEdit.where: radial-gradient class on the overlay i element
transition style on the ul element

needsCodeEdit.change: Make items link to real pages
needsCodeEdit.where: the a element with onClick preventDefault

fixed: Fills the viewport height with a hidden-overflow full-bleed layout
Renders an empty background-colored placeholder until mounted
